_comment: Calendars the dashboard shows. Read-only subscriptions to .ics URLs - nothing here can change your calendars, it only reads them.
_how_to_get_a_google_url: calendar.google.com on a computer, not the phone app
hover the calendar in the left list, three dots, Settings and sharing
copy 'Secret address in iCal format' - the one ending .ics
treat it like a password: anyone with it can read that calendar
_how_to_get_an_outlook_or_school_url: under 'Publish a calendar' pick the calendar and 'Can view all details'
Publish, then copy the ICS link, not the HTML one
if your university has disabled publishing, ask me and we will find another way

_fields.id: Short, unique, used for the cache filename.
_fields.name: What it is called on the dashboard.
_fields.color: Any CSS colour, used for the dot next to each event.
_fields.refreshMinutes: How often to re-download. 60 is plenty for a timetable.
_fields.disabled: true to keep the entry but stop fetching it.

calendars.name: Personal
calendars._note: Paste your Google secret iCal URL into url, then set disabled to false.

calendars.name: School
calendars._note: Your university calendar. Same idea - paste the ICS link and enable it.
